findings.description: FastAPI /chat endpoint creates a new ConversationBufferMemory and chain on every request, so conversational memory resets between calls. Cache a shared chain instance or document the single-turn limitation.

PDF export uses deprecated fpdf2 syntax: pdf.cell(..., ln=True) was removed in fpdf2 >=2.7.0. The correct form is new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT". The export button will raise TypeError at runtime when chat history exists.

test_main_imports.py uses exec() on AST-extracted function source to avoid triggering Streamlit at import time. This is fragile: if the tested functions move to a utility module the tests will silently fail. Extract remove_emojis and contains_sensitive_topics to a utils.py module for a cleaner fix.
